# REMAINING WORK — All Pages Extreme

The Awtsmoos renews every route before any stylesheet can claim permanence; Awtsmoos.com therefore asks each page to receive a precise garment, local to its vessel, simple at first glance and infinitely expandable beneath.

## Mission

Transform every production Geelooy page family into a clean, mobile-first, retractable, futuristic interface with localized styling, complete interaction states, bounded layering, overflow safety, better documentation, and progressively simplified JavaScript/API surfaces.

## Known production families

- [ ] Home/root shell.
- [ ] Apps catalogue and shared future-system verification.
- [ ] Social Hub and shared social shells.
- [ ] Docs.
- [ ] Drive.
- [ ] Editor/post/heichel authoring family.
- [ ] Heichel/heichelos/read/review family.
- [ ] Profile/social/comment/thread/entity family.
- [ ] Authentication/register/MFA/account surfaces.
- [ ] Notifications/email/messages/media surfaces.
- [ ] Games/game/procedural-world pages.
- [ ] OS/node-os/control/db/awtai-db/git/admin tooling.
- [ ] AI/ocr/fetch/parsers/web-scrapers utilities.
- [ ] Legal/about/contact/donate informational pages.
- [ ] Reeyuh/record/recorder/youtube/zmanim and remaining media/tools.
- [ ] Archive/test/generated fixtures classified and excluded from production migrations unless actually routed.

## Cross-cutting obligations

- [ ] No unscoped route CSS introduced.
- [ ] Every migrated stylesheet rooted to a page contract or route-owned component root.
- [ ] All interactive controls receive hover, active, focus-visible, disabled, selected/open/busy states where semantically relevant.
- [ ] Touch targets remain mobile-safe.
- [ ] Horizontal overflow eliminated at 320px unless intentionally scrollable.
- [ ] Fixed/sticky layers use explicit local layer tokens and never arbitrary giant z-index values.
- [ ] Reduced-motion and forced-colors remain functional.
- [ ] Advanced controls retract by default where complexity would otherwise crowd the page.
- [ ] All touched JavaScript remains modular, data-first, documented, and compatible with existing callers.
- [ ] All touched files retain B"H / Boruch Hashem / Blessed is He headers and meaningful Awtsmoos/Awtsmoos.com documentation.
- [ ] All touched source files use tabs and remain under the project line ceiling through module splits.
- [ ] Browser smoke and console/network checks performed after each route-family wave.
- [ ] Documentation updated after verified behavior, not before.

## Current evidence

- Apps and Future System already received a major route-local mobile-first pass.
- Social Hub already owns a large import-based local CSS system and modular JS architecture; its remaining debt is HTML density, mobile disclosure, consistency, and runtime/browser proof rather than absence of modularity.
- Root Geelooy contains dozens of route families; blanket global CSS is explicitly rejected.
- Procedural-core enhancement remains a parallel mission with staged rock/texture/botany/grass architecture awaiting reliable native source promotion.

## NEXT_ACTION

Audit Social Hub local style modules for selector scope, overflow, z-index, and interaction-state gaps; then rewrite only proven weak modules and simplify dense shell markup without changing required DOM IDs or JS contracts.
